designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1947 when Maurice and Cecile Wertheim donated their land on the Carmans River, Long Island, to the federal government for a wildlife refuge.

authority.citation: Land donation to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Wertheim National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

review.note: Year confirmed by a secondary chronology; weak sourcing.
